title: The Wild Veil Again
author: Theo Dravenmoor
blurb: Lena Whitlock, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
